links.outcome: Clinician evaluation of cost-benefit threshold visualization and LLM patient-level analysis for decision support
links.effect: System was well received by clinicians, but feedback stressed the need to improve technical accuracy for speculative tasks. No comparator; clinician evaluation was qualitative and no numbers were reported in the abstract.
links.quote: The system was well received according to the evaluation by clinicians.

unlisted_practices: Clinical impact projection curves that visualize quality-of-life, treatment and error costs across decision thresholds
LLM agents generating patient-specific cost-benefit descriptions of ML predictions

screen.reason: Evaluates a clinician-facing decision support system (CAP) combining predictive risk models with LLM agents for cost-benefit explanations, tested with clinician evaluation offline.
